card.name: Inside interacting drug class names
card.fires_on: Partway through or at the end of names of interacting drugs or drug classes, such as MAOIs, warfarin, phenytoin, anticoagulants and muscle relaxants, in drug-interaction text. Also on a few linking words in storage and use statements.
